author: Mary Barnett
text: Connor & his team did a great job for our city water & sewer installation!  They came when they said they would, worked long hours to get the job done -- and done right.  Wonderful people to deal with.  They deliver top notch workmanship at fair, honest prices -- you can't beat this company!  Highly recommend.

author: Tyler Kiser
text: Had a water heater issue at 6:30am on Good Friday of all days; Connor had his team here in less than an hour and got it all taken care of. Can’t thank these gentlemen enough for your quick response! 10/10

author: Ryan Houge
text: Great company. Recently had Connor install a couple new toilets, 1 which had a defective part right out of the box. Without flinching he called on his resources and had the part brought out to the house so he could complete the job instead of having to come back another day/time. Quick work and perfect installation, would easily use this company again and again for any of my plumbing needs!

author: Laura Sliwicki
text: We’ve had two amazing experiences with this company. Connor and Chris are an excellent team! Connor went above and beyond our expectations. We would highly recommend to anyone. We will be using Wausau Plumbing Plus for all our future plumbing needs. Thank you!

author: Beverly Wegner
text: Most professional plumbing service I have ever seen. Installers were on time, kind and considerate of my needs. They muscled thru to complete the install, waiting for Connor to personally deliver a seal replacement that was damaged from shipping. Outstanding service with a big heart and genuine quality professional service. God bless your business success.
